procurement.title: Procurement
procurement.lede: Needs, requests to suppliers and quotes, within your authority.
procurement.emptyHint: A need can be run on behalf of the company or personally for your own project.
procurement.flowsNote: Creating needs, comparing quotes and orders come in the next stage. This list is shown within your rights.
procurement.createDisabled: Creating needs comes in the next stage.
procurement.needsDecision: Your decision is needed: quotes are collected, choose the terms.

how.title: How procurement goes
how.need: Describe the need: composition, quantity, region and deadline.
how.quotes: Suppliers send quotes for a specific version of the request.
how.compare: Compare the terms, ask questions, choose the best.
how.order: Place the order; the supplier confirms acceptance.
how.accept: Accept the delivery and leave a review of the supplier.
how.note: Prices and budgets are never published on the site.

procurement.findHint: Verified companies with catalogues, projects and reviews.
